texts:
This three.ws avatar takes requests. One click plays a move: a boxer dance, a back flip, an arm flex, a brag and clap. The number keys set her face, from a smile to a wink to surprise.

Every clip is retargeted onto her own skeleton live in the browser, so the same library plays on any humanoid avatar you bring.

The embed is a real control surface for your site. Your page can make the avatar speak with lip sync, set any of the 52 ARKit face shapes, turn her head toward something, or hand her the webcam for live motion capture.

Drop one into your own page: three.ws/docs/embedding

issues.problem: The opening is a vague feature statement, not a mechanism or number lead. "takes requests" also implies natural-language input that is not evidenced; the product shows button clicks.
issues.fix: Delete the first sentence and open with "One click plays a move on this three.ws avatar" so the post leads with the mechanism.

issues.problem: "real" is an uncheckable marketing adjective that reads as copywriting.
issues.fix: Remove "real": "The embed is a control surface for your site."
